drafted_from: tools/check-every-screen-at-every-width/tool-rows.json (its sample run), check-given-pages.mjs, check-screens.mjs and views.json; the sample was run here on 2026-11-13
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check my garden club notice page on a phone and a desktop, in light and dark mode, and tell me any text that is hard to read." It runs tool:check-given-pages-at-every-width on the page's HTML.
no_lists_because: It takes the pages in its input, writes no file and keeps nothing after the run.
instructions: 1. Put the HTML of each page in screens as {id, html}; add route, fonts (the font families the page declares) or steps when the page needs them.
2. Say "Check these pages at every width", or name widths (phone, tablet, desktop) and modes (light, dark, forced, darkreader) to read fewer.

3. Read what comes back: passed is true only when failures is empty; each failure names the screen, width, mode, probe (contrast, font, overflow, horizontal-scroll, control_name or open), the selector, the text and why.
4. Fix each failing text in the page and run the check again; counts shows how many failures each probe found.

worked_examples.title: A notice with one faint line fails contrast in four views
worked_examples.ask: Check my garden club notice at phone and desktop width, in light and dark mode.

screens.html:
Garden club notice

The next meeting is on Saturday morning.

Bring your own gloves.

worked_examples.given: Observed on 2026-11-13: this input run through checkGivenPages in tools/check-every-screen-at-every-width/check-given-pages.mjs (the sample run in its own tool-rows.json). The headline and the first paragraph read fine; the paragraph in #c8c8c8 on white is under the 4.5 bar in every view because the page sets its own colours in dark mode too. The report's seconds and timing vary between runs and are left out here.
